name: SE40 Universal Silencer
summary: Universal silencer rated 28 dB(A), for exhaust bores from 2 in to 20 in.
description: The SE40 Universal Silencer is rated at 28 dB(A) attenuation and is listed on its datasheet for exhaust bores from 2 in to 20 in (51 mm to 508 mm).
options: BS10 Table ‘D’ flanges fitted as standard
Alternative flange patterns available on request
B.S.P. connections available on smaller sizes
Heat resisting aluminium or black paint
Shot blast and aluminium metal sprayed
drawingAlt: SE40 universal silencer datasheet with options list, dimension drawing and size table
tableNotes: Side and bottom inlets & outlets available on request.
